subject: general
question: Who is the Chief Minister of Himanchal Pradesh, as of January 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu:-**

 
 
• **He is the Chief Minister of Himachal Pradesh, as of January 2023. **
 
• He was sworn in as the 15th Chief Minister of Himachal Pradesh on December 12, 2022.
 
• **He is a member of the Indian National Congress. **
 
• He was born on March 27, 1964, in Nadaun, Hamirpur district, Himachal Pradesh. He is the son of Rasil Singh, a bus driver.
 
• Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu started his political career in 1982, when he was elected as Class Representative at Government Degree College, Sanjauli.
 
• He was elected General Secretary of the college in 1983 and President in 1984.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pushkar Singh Dhami:-**

 
 
• He is the 12th and current Chief Minister of Uttarakhand, India. He is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).
 
• He was sworn in as Chief Minister on July 3, 2021, following the resignation of Tirath Singh Rawat.
 
 
 
• **Bhupesh Baghel:-**
 
 
• He is the 3rd and current Chief Minister of Chhattisgarh, India. He is a member of the Indian National Congress (INC).
 
• He was sworn in as Chief Minister on December 17, 2018, following the resignation of Raman Singh.
 
 
 
• **Ashok Gehlot:-**
 
 
• He is an Indian politician serving as the 15th and current Chief Minister of Rajasthan since 2018.
 
• He held this position from December 1998 to 2003, and from 2008 to 2013.
